Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands - including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch.

Postscript is the leading AI-powered conversational commerce platform for Shopify brands, trusted by 20,000+ stores. We're all-in on SMS with one goal: make it the #1 revenue channel for the merchants we serve. Backed by Greylock, Y Combinator, and other top investors, we're growing fast and looking for remarkable people to help build a world-class organization.
Merchants don't run Postscript in isolation. They run it alongside a stack of loyalty, subscription, reviews, support, and data tools - and the connections between those tools are where a lot of untapped revenue sits. This role owns that surface area.

title: Langfuse - Senior Backend Engineer
description:
WHY BACKEND ENGINEERING AT LANGFUSE

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.

The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time.

You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment.

 

You won’t be solving these problems alone. Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the people who built the database you’re optimizing are one channel away. Few backend roles give you that kind of access to the internals of your core datastore.

 

YOU WILL GROW AT LANGFUSE BY

- Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.

- Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals - and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away.

- Build new infrastructure-heavy features: things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those.

- Test with real data in production: when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing.

- Scale for what's next: we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale.

 

LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR INFRASTRUCTURE

- From Zero to Scale: Langfuse's Infrastructure Evolution https://langfuse.com/blog/2024-12-langfuse-v3-infrastructure-evolution - deep dive into how we went from Postgres to ClickHouse

- Max talking infrastructure at ClickHouse OpenHouse Amsterdam https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NXYQ5odATrM - recording of our CTO walking through the architecture

- Architecture https://langfuse.com/handbook/product-engineering/architecture

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong backend engineer who gets excited about database internals, query optimization, and distributed systems

- You get excited when working with a ton of data

- Experience with analytical databases, data pipelines, or high-throughput event processing. ClickHouse experience is a big plus but not required

- You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about what to build and how to ship it

- Comfortable reading and writing TypeScript (our backend) and SQL

- Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment talking to users about their scaling challenges

- Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

- CS or quantitative degree preferred

 

Bonus points:

 

- Experience with ClickHouse, other OLAP databases, or observability infrastructure

- Former founder

- Background in building data-intensive systems at scale

title: (Senior) Software Engineer // Odoo Developer (m/w/d)

Deine Rolle
Bei uns bist du Teil des Teams - kein Backoffice-Job. Als Entwickler sitzt du nicht isoliert hinter deinem Terminal, sondern arbeitest nah an Kunden und Beratung. Du hilfst mit, Lösungen zu finden und zu erarbeiten, statt nur fertige Tickets abzuarbeiten.
Konkret heißt das:

• Du entwickelst, erweiterst und integrierst Odoo-Lösungen für unsere Kunden - von der Anforderung bis zur produktiven Lösung.

• Du arbeitest an unseren Standardprodukten mit und kannst dort echte Produktverantwortung übernehmen. Du bist also nicht nur in wechselnden Projekten unterwegs, sondern entwickelst Produkte, die wachsen und bleiben.

• Du unterstützt unsere Kunden und die Beratung bei der Lösungsfindung - technisch, pragmatisch und auf Augenhöhe.

• Du bringst neue Themen in unsere eigene Infrastruktur und Prozesse ein. Für unsere internen Abläufe entstehen laufend neue Anforderungen, die verankert und eingebunden werden wollen - hier gestaltest du aktiv mit.

Das bringst du mit:

•
Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst sie voran, ohne dass man dich schieben muss.

•
Technologische Offenheit und Breite: Du legst dich nicht auf eine einzige Technologie fest, sondern arbeitest dich gern in Neues ein. Python und das Odoo-Framework sind dein Zuhause oder werden es schnell; XML, PostgreSQL, JavaScript/OWL, REST-APIs und Git sind dir vertraut oder reizen dich. Mit Docker und Linux kommst du klar, und der Umgang mit CI/CD-Pipelines ist dir vertraut oder du willst da rein. Kubernetes ist ein nettes Extra, aber kein Muss.

•
Kundenkontakt liegt dir: Du kannst auch im direkten Austausch mit Kunden bestehen, hörst zu, übersetzt zwischen Fachlichkeit und Technik und vertrittst Lösungen souverän.

•
Engagement für Neues: Neue Themen, Produkte und Projekte siehst du als Chance, nicht als Last. Du engagierst dich und denkst über den Tellerrand der einzelnen Aufgabe und des einzelnen Projektes hinaus.

•

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
TL;DR:
Lovable's mobile app (React Native, iOS/Android, owned by Team Everywhere) mirrors the web app's accounts/projects/credits while adding native login, push notifications, in-app top-ups, and haptics - it's one of the fastest-growing ways builders reach Lovable. The role is a product-minded fullstack engineer to own end-to-end mobile slices: native flows, auth, push, the web-native bridge, and app store ops (TestFlight, Play Console, compliance) across the full stack.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

- At least 6 years of relevant experience at high-pace, high-scale companies

- Strong fullstack background: deep comfort with TypeScript/React on the frontend and Node.js or similar on the backend

- Hands-on experience with React Native in production, including native module integration.

- Experience shipping and maintaining apps through the App Store and Google Play, including review/compliance cycles (Sign in with Apple, IAP, Android policy review)

- Product instinct: you think in user outcomes, not just API endpoints

- Comfort working with third-party services and building clean abstractions over vendor APIs. Familiarity with managed cloud services (AWS, GCP) and the tradeoffs of buy-vs-build

- Experience with push notification infrastructure or native device integrations is a strong plus

- You've shipped features in fast-moving, high-ownership environments where you wore multiple hats

What you’ll do

- Build and own native mobile features end-to-end: onboarding, auth, push notifications, in-app purchases/credit top-ups, and share targets

- Improve the web-native bridge that connects the in-app WebView experience to native device capabilities (keyboard handling, haptics, camera, file sharing)

- Own App Store and Play Store submissions, review compliance, and release tooling (TestFlight, Play Console, Fastlane)

- Diagnose and fix native-specific bugs and performance issues (cold start, preview loading, crash handling) across iOS and Android

Our Tech Stack
We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:

- Mobile: React Native, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin

- Frontend: React and Typescript

- Backend: Golang and Rust

- Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Firebase

- Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery

- DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Kubernetes, Terraform, Fastlane

And always on the lookout for what's next!

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: (Senior) Backend Software Engineer (Java) - Metadata Platform DB
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model - which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer (Java), mid to senior level, to join the Metadata Platform DB team. This team owns Postgres end-to-end - from infrastructure and provisioning to the software layer that sits on top of it - and is looking for someone to help maintain and grow that ecosystem.

The Team

Metadata Platform DB owns Postgres provisioning and infrastructure as code, along with a set of Java (and one Rust) components built around it, including a core client library, a database proxy, a schema management tool, and a fork of an open-source sharding solution.

The Tech Stack

• Cloud Infrastructure: Cloud-native platform, expanding beyond current AWS and Azure dependencies toward provider-agnostic deployment.

• Core Technologies: Java, Postgres.

• Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, a Go-based operator.

• Systems components: Rust (database proxy).

• Containerization: Kubernetes.

• DevOps: Kustomize, GitHub CI, ArgoCD/Kargo, Datadog for metrics/logs/APM.

The Work You'll Do

• Take ownership of one or more Java components in the Postgres ecosystem, including newly onboarded ones.

• Work alongside the infrastructure-as-code side of the stack (Terraform, operators) to understand how your components are provisioned and operated.

• Improve reliability, performance, and security of the components you own.

• Where applicable, maintain forks of open-source projects - tracking upstream changes and making deliberate calls about merging versus diverging.

• Collaborate with teams handing off components and with downstream consumers.

• Document processes, concepts, and decisions as ownership transitions and components evolve.

The Qualifications You Need

• Solid professional experience building Java applications (3+ years mid-level, 7+ years senior).

• Experience with infrastructure and IaC concepts - comfort working with or alongside Terraform or similar provisioning tooling.

• Experience building, packaging, and debugging applications in containerized and Kubernetes environments (Docker/OCI).

• Experience with databases (Postgres preferred over InnoDB/MySQL, with a good grasp of Postgres MVCC and concurrency mechanics from an application perspective) and distributed systems.

• Experience writing and maintaining unit and integration tests.

• Strong communication skills in English and a passion for clean, maintainable code.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with Rust or Go.

• Experience maintaining a fork of an open-source project.

• Hands-on Terraform experience.

• Experience with monitoring and log analysis tools (e.g., Datadog).

• Familiarity with agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex).

What Celonis can offer you:

• Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

• Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

• Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy-24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

• Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO

title: Assistant Vice President OR Senior Underwriter, Global Agriculture Reinsurance
description:
Skyward Specialty is a rapidly growing specialty Property & Casualty insurance carrier headquartered in Houston, Texas. We deliver tailored solutions across nine specialized underwriting divisions, with a culture grounded in deep technical expertise, decisive underwriting, and long-term broker and client relationships. Our Global Agriculture division underwrites a worldwide portfolio of agriculture reinsurance, partnering with cedants and reinsurance brokers across multiple territories to support food and farm economies through thoughtfully structured treaty solutions.
Position Summary
The Assistant Vice President OR Senior Underwriter, Global Agriculture Reinsurance is a senior technical underwriting role responsible for supporting, expanding, maintaining, and managing Skyward's global portfolio of agriculture reinsurance. The role underwrites and prices new and renewal treaty submissions, shapes portfolio strategy, and represents Skyward in the reinsurance market with brokers and ceding company clients.
This is a high-authority individual-contributor position for a proven (re)insurance professional who is at their best evaluating complex treaty business, forming a defensible technical view of risk, and building durable broker and client relationships. The role can be filled at the Senior Underwriter or Assistant Vice President level depending on the candidate's experience and underwriting authority. It reports to the Head of Global Agriculture and partners closely with Actuarial, Claims, Finance, and Accounting.
Key Responsibilities

• Perform in-depth technical underwriting and analysis of treaty reinsurance business across the global agriculture portfolio, including proportional and non-proportional structures.

• Underwrite and price new and renewal agriculture reinsurance submissions, applying delegated underwriting authority and pricing methodologies appropriate to crop, livestock, and related agricultural risks.

• Review primary policy forms, reinsurance contract wording, and endorsements to confirm coverage intent, terms, and conditions are accurately reflected and aligned with Skyward's risk appetite.

• Evaluate exposure, loss history, accumulation, and program structure to form a clear, defensible technical view of each opportunity.

• Provide support for strategic planning and ongoing management of the global agriculture portfolio, including profitability monitoring, portfolio construction, and renewal strategy.

• Market, develop, and maintain strong broker and ceding-client relationships, representing Skyward in the market and at industry events.

• Monitor market development and explore trends and cycles in agriculture reinsurance, translating those insights into actionable recommendations.

• Partner with Accounting, Finance, Claims, and Actuarial on monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting and on reserving and planning processes.

• Serve as a senior technical resource to analysts and less-experienced team members, contributing to underwriting guidelines, pricing tools, and best practices (AVP level).

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in agricultural economics, finance, risk management, actuarial science, mathematics, or a related field; advanced degree or professional designations (CPCU, ARe, ACAS/FCAS, or similar) a plus.

• Seven or more years of (re)insurance experience, with a meaningful portion in agriculture, treaty reinsurance, or a closely related specialty line; calibrated toward the AVP end for candidates with broader portfolio or market-facing exposure.

• Demonstrated treaty underwriting and pricing experience, including familiarity with proportional and non-proportional structures.

• Working knowledge of agriculture insurance and reinsurance products and the global agriculture risk landscape.

• Strong command of reinsurance contract and policy wording and the ability to identify coverage and structural issues.

• Proficiency with pricing and exposure analysis tools and strong Excel skills;

Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert - u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kenn

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more .

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. 

 

About the Role

Riskified is seeking an Assistant Controller to support our expanding Finance team. In this high-impact role, you will build robust accounting infrastructure and controls while collaborating cross-functionally to drive company growth. We are looking for an analytical, self-driven finance professional ready to make a key contribution to a dynamic, scaling organization.

What You'll Be Doing

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless flow of billing information and its accurate representation in financial statements.

• Build weekly and monthly reports and monitor KPI’s.

• Support SOX compliance requirements and related controls.

• Drive operational improvement initiatives, including automation, AI tools, and FinOps workflow optimization.

• Guide and train Sales teams on accurate data entry and proper system usage.

• Work closely with Deal Desk, Sales, Development, Product, Business Applications, and Legal teams.

• Support and manage the monthly billing cycle, including recurring billing inquiries.

title: Tech Talent Acquisition Specialist (12 months FTC)
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As our organisation continues to grow, attracting the best talent remains one of our highest priorities. To achieve this, it's essential to adapt by refining our recruitment strategies, upholding exceptional quality in our efforts, and embracing innovative recruitment methodologies. This is where our Talent Acquisition (TA) team plays a vital role.

In the role of Tech Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will play a pivotal part in achieving the team's primary goal: attracting and hiring the right talent for Vinted while ensuring an outstanding candidate experience. Leveraging your expertise in recruitment, you will implement best hiring practices and collaborate with other team members on various projects. You will focus on supporting our key tech areas, including Engineering, Product Management, Data Science & Analytics, Design, and Research, to ensure we secure the best talent for these functions (note: your specific focus may shift based on business needs).

If you're excited to contribute to our team's efforts in supporting our organisation's growth, we would love to meet you.

Note. This role is offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract initially. There may be an opportunity for the position to be made permanent in the future, depending on business needs.

In this position, you’ll 

• Collaborate with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and ensure a seamless interview process to attract the right talent

• Lead the end-to-end recruitment process, including job posting, proactive candidate sourcing, conducting interviews, and extending offers

• Build effective candidate talent pools through proactive sourcing, job boards, employee referrals, social media & employer branding campaigns etc

• Guide hiring managers and interviewers on effective interview techniques and candidate evaluation methods

• Track and report on key hiring metrics to ensure efficient recruitment processes, while providing a positive candidate and hiring manager experience

• Gain exposure to talent acquisition initiatives by contributing to process improvement projects

• Stay informed about recruitment best practices and tools to continually improve the candidate experience

About you 

• Previous experience as a Sourcer, Recruiter or Talent Acquisition Specialist specifically focused on hiring for tech roles

• Proficiency in sourcing candidates using LinkedIn and other recruitment tools

• Strong skills in candidate engagement and relationship building

We are Olsson . We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results - for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson . It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description
Olsson provides multidisciplinary design services for some of the largest and most forward-thinking and desirable companies in the world to work for. We design large hyperscale data center campuses and colocation data centers throughout the U.S.. This role will give you the opportunity to work on some of the largest and most complex engineering-driven projects being built today. Our clients are relationship based and truly value the work we do for them, affording us the opportunity to contribute to society’s technological and connected community through the design of the critical infrastructure that is the foundation of these projects.
As a Senior Civil Designer with a grading & utility focus, you will work in a collaborative team environment on multi-disciplinary complex projects. You will work closely with licensed engineers on plans and calculations, utilizing your expertise in Civil 3D and CAD software. In addition to sheet production work, you will also independently design utilities and surfaces with the oversight of an Engineer. You will need advanced skills in Civil 3D and CAD software to create accurate and efficient design solutions to develop detailed drawings and models to communicate design intent effectively. A Senior Civil Designer for this team will frequently design utilizing Pipe Networks, Pressure Pipe Networks, and Surfaces containing Corridors, and Feature Lines. Scale of projects for this team start at roughly 20 acres and are often 200+ acres for a single campus.
We have several current openings and will consider candidates interested in being located out of any Olsson office location, hybrid, or fully remote in various locations of the US. This role includes flexible work options to accommodate diverse working preferences and promote work-life balance.

• Using your talents to positively affect communities

• Empowering others to use their talents

• Strong communication skills

• Associate’s degree in drafting or related field preferred

• 8 or more years of expertise in drafting and design

• Experience in surface creation, analysis, utility design, and BIM coordination

• Proficiency in Civil 3D software

title: Deployed Engineer (Bay Area)

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

This team works directly with companies building and running AI agents in production, helping turn ideas and prototypes into systems teams can rely on.

This is a hands-on, highly technical team that partners closely with customer engineers across the full lifecycle, from pre-sales evaluations to post-deployment advisory work. - Occasionally contribute code upstream when it meaningfully improves customer outcomes

- This role requires 40% travel to customer sites to support deployment, onboarding, and ongoing technical engagement

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 3+ years in a relevant technical role (software engineering, customer engineering, solutions engineering, founding/product engineering), ideally in a startup or scale-up

- Strong Python, JavaScript and systems fundamentals

- Have designed agent-based or LLM-powered applications beyond simple API calls, including multi-step workflows, orchestration, and failure handling

- Are comfortable working directly with customers during POCs, architecture reviews, and technical evaluations

- Can explain technical tradeoffs clearly and build trust with developer audiences

- Take responsibility for outcomes, not just recommendations

- Have a bias toward action and enjoy figuring things out as you go

- Are excited about operating AI agents in production, not just building demos

title: Senior Compute Infrastructure Engineer
description:
• About StackYak

StackYak is building the infrastructure layer for AI.
We are an early-stage, funded company building software that brings compute, GPU infrastructure, networking, and inference together into one product. The opportunity is large, the market is moving quickly, and we are building for real production workloads from the start.
This is not internal IT. This is not a slow-moving infrastructure team maintaining someone else's platform. The infrastructure is the product .
We are a small, senior team with very little bureaucracy. This is a founding role in its discipline. You will be the first person here whose primary responsibility is the systems layer beneath the product, and the shape it takes will largely be yours to decide.
Treat this document as a starting point rather than a boundary. The people who do well here take ground early and are not asked to give it back.
We move quickly. We do not have months for someone to learn the fundamentals of their discipline. You should already be very good at what you do, be able to ramp into adjacent areas quickly, and be comfortable operating without perfect requirements or neatly defined boundaries.
The Role
We need someone who knows what stands between GPU capacity and production infrastructure , and can build it.
That capacity does not arrive in one form. Some of it comes as hardware, with everything that implies: firmware, drivers, hosts, and physical work carried out by people you will never meet in buildings you will rarely visit. Some of it comes from neoclouds and other providers, where you control the software and very little else, on terms set by someone whose interests are not yours.
The interesting problem is neither of those on its own. It is the gap between them - how much of it can honestly be abstracted away, how much has to stay visible, and how much the rest of the company should ever have to think about. Those are open questions here, and the person in this role is the one who gets to answer them.
You should be comfortable at both ends. On one side: Linux, kernel, firmware, drivers, virtualization, host hardening, and debugging a machine you cannot walk up to. On the other: provider APIs, capacity that is not permanent, and automation at a scale where nothing gets configured by hand.
Workloads will run on bare metal, in VMs, and in containers. The right answer will not be the same one twice, and choosing is part of the job.
This is not an architecture-only role. You will design systems and then build, debug, and operate them.
What You Will Own
Not tasks. Outcomes, and the authority that comes with them.

• What the fleet is. What we own versus what we rent, where we standardise and where we deliberately do not, and what it costs us either way.

• The machines themselves. Linux, kernel, firmware, drivers, CUDA and/or ROCm - down to the layer where the answer lives in a changelog rather than documentation.

• Bare metal, VM, or container. You own the boundary between them, and the uncomfortable fact that the right answer will not be the same one twice.

• Isolation. What we claim about keeping customers and workloads apart, and whether that claim survives someone attacking it.

• Provisioning and recovery. A machine goes from nothing to serving, and from broken back to serving, without you personally being involved.

• Provider integration. Neoclouds and other compute vendors: what each of them actually gives you as opposed to what they advertise, and the seams that difference creates.

• Physical reality. Specifying hardware, and getting it from a purchase order to a booting machine through vendors, data-center partners, and remote hands you have never met.

• Failures that cross layers , where the cause could be hardware, firmware, OS, virtualization, storage, or network, and nobody else wants to own the question.

• Making it operable by other people , so the fleet does not quietly become a collection of one-off machines only you understand.

We are currently seeking Data Privacy Lawyers  to work with a variety of Axiom clients across industries, supporting one of the largest privacy teams in the UK on flexible in-house engagements.

Responsibilities:

• Provide practical, business-focused advice on data protection and privacy compliance, including GDPR, UK GDPR, ePrivacy, international data transfers, data governance, and related regulatory frameworks.

• Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements involving data protection and data-sharing provisions, including DPAs, intra-group agreements, vendor contracts, technology agreements, and data processing terms.

• Lead on key privacy deliverables, including DPIAs, LIAs, data mapping, DSAR responses, privacy notices, records of processing, and internal privacy policies and procedures.

• Support the design and implementation of privacy frameworks, data governance programmes, vendor risk processes, and compliance controls, working closely with legal, compliance, product, technology, and business teams.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Qualified lawyer in the UK or an equivalent jurisdiction with strong data protection, privacy, or information law experience.

• Strong working knowledge of core data protection regimes, including GDPR, UK GDPR, ePrivacy, and broader privacy, digital, and data-related regulatory developments.

• Experience gained in private practice, in-house or consulting supporting commercial, technology, data-driven, or regulated organisations.

• Solid understanding of the data lifecycle, privacy risk management, data governance, commercial privacy issues, and the ability to deliver clear, pragmatic, business-focused advice.&lt

Oddball believes that the best products are built when companies understand and value the things they are working on. We value learning and growth and the ability to make a big impact at a small company. We believe that we can make big changes happen and improve the daily lives of millions of people by bringing quality software to the federal space.

Over Webmastery

Webmastery is een groeiende social enterprise die webcare en contentcreatie verzorgt voor goede doelen en andere kennisintensieve organisaties die zich inzetten voor een mooiere samenleving. Denk aan Alzheimer Nederland, VluchtelingenWerk en Kinderpostzegels.

Flexibel en inclusief werken
Bij Webmastery werk je:

• Vanuit huis - of een andere plek die voor jou prettig werkt.

• Op tijden die bij jou passen - zodat je werkt wanneer je energie hebt.

Wij geloven niet in vaste functieprofielen, maar bewegen mee met jouw talent en hetgeen waar jij energie van krijgt. Daarom kun je je eigen takenpakket samenstellen.

🕣 3 of 6 uur per dag op 2 tot 5 dagen in de week rondom het weekend (donderdag tot maandag).

👩‍🎓 Je hebt hbo-denk- en werkniveau.

💲 Salaris marktconform, zie loonwijzer.nl functie: medewerker klantenservice.

Webcare buiten eigen socials

Je speurt het internet af naar gesprekken over maatschappelijke thema’s van onze opdrachtgevers en zorgt dat de goede doelen zichtbaar aanwezig zijn in die gesprekken. title: Junior Sensor Network Operator
description:
About Sybilla Technologies
At Sybilla Technologies , we develop advanced Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Space Situational Awareness (SSA) solutions that help governments, defense organizations, commercial operators and research institutions better understand, monitor and protect the space environment.

Our technologies support mission-critical operations where reliability, precision, and operational excellence are essential. We combine advanced optical observation systems, data analytics, and automation to deliver solutions that contribute to the safety, security, and sustainability of space activities.

Joining Sybilla Technologies means becoming part of a growing deep-tech company where engineering excellence, customer partnership and continuous innovation go hand in hand.

About the role
We are looking for a Junior Sensor Network Operator to join our Sensor Network Operations team and support the day-to-day operation of Sybilla Technologies ' Global Sensor Network.
This is a hands-on operational role focused on ensuring that our sensors and robotic observatories operate reliably and that observation campaigns are executed on time and according to established standards.
You will monitor the health and operational status of the sensor network, execute routine and special observation campaigns, support troubleshooting and maintenance activities and assist with sensor deployments and commissioning.
You will also work with observation data and operational systems supporting activities such as launches, fragmentation events, payload separation, station keeping, manoeuvres, collision avoidance, satellite attitude monitoring and catalogue maintenance.

The role combines technical operations, observation execution and problem solving. It requires attention to detail, reliability and the ability to follow procedures while responding effectively when something does not work as expected.

As this is a junior position, you do not need to know everything from day one. You will receive dedicated onboarding and work closely with experienced specialists who will support your development in sensor operations, SSA/SDA and optical observation systems.

What you'll do

• Monitor the health, availability and operational status of Sybilla Technologies ' Global Sensor Network.

• Execute routine and special observation campaigns according to defined priorities and procedures.

• Create and support the execution of observing campaigns for different operational and customer requirements.

• Monitor observation execution, data acquisition status and overall operational performance.

• Support operational activities related to launches, payload separation, fragmentation events, station keeping, manoeuvres, collision avoidance, catalogue maintenance and attitude monitoring.

• Monitor the timeliness and quality of observation data and identify potential anomalies or irregularities.

• Perform first-level troubleshooting and diagnostics of sensors, observatories and related operational systems.

• Escalate operational incidents according to established procedures.

• Support preventive and corrective maintenance activities for sensors and robotic observatories.

• Contact local support teams when basic on-site assistance is required.

• Support sensor deployment, installation, commissioning and acceptance activities under the supervision of experienced team members.

• Help ensure the safety, security and operational readiness of robotic observatories.

• Prepare technical notes and documentation related to observation campaigns and operational activities.

• Maintain operational logs, incident records, shift handovers and technical documentation.

• Support testing and validation of new operational tools, procedures and system improvements.

• Collaborate with engineering, software, data and operational teams to improve scheduling strategies, reporting tools, databases and operational processes.

title: Business Development Representative

This isn't just a "cold calling" role-it’s an opportunity to learn the art of B2B sales at a high-growth SaaS company and play a direct role in our global expansion.
The Impact You’ll Have
As a BDR, you are the first point of contact for our future customers. You’ll spend your time identifying key stakeholders at the world's largest corporations and non-profits, initiating conversations about how Quorum can transform their advocacy work. You’ll bridge the gap between marketing interest and closed deals, directly impacting our revenue and company success from day one.
About the Revenue Team

• We are Solution-Oriented: We strive to understand our buyers’ challenges and recommend solutions that enable them to achieve their goals.

• We are Thought Leaders: We follow political news and government affairs trends daily to stay ahead of the curve.

• We are Supportive: We foster an environment where peer-to-peer feedback is encouraged to drive both personal and professional growth.

• We are Respectful: We earn client trust by taking an intentionally respectful approach to our competition.

• We are Growth Drivers: We understand, appreciate, and are motivated by the fact that our everyday work is a critical driver for annual company growth.

What You’ll Do

• Generate Pipeline: Hit your monthly targets by reaching out to a high volume of prospects via phone and email.

• Strategic Analysis: Don't just spray and pray. You'll analyze target accounts and the competitive landscape to tailor your outreach for maximum impact.

• Tech-Forward Sales: Use best-in-class sales tools and AI-driven strategies to optimize your conversion rates and manage your pipeline in Salesforce.

• Collaborate on Campaigns: Help plan and execute account-based marketing efforts and events to engage our top prospects.

About You

• The Self-Starter: You’re highly motivated, results-driven, and excited to hit (and exceed) monthly targets and have cold calling experience .

• The Communicator: You have excellent written and verbal skills and the "people skills" to build rapport quickly over the phone.

title: Temporary Staff Accountant (Contract / Project-Based)
description:
Category: Financial Services

Location:

Atlas Advisors LLC is seeking a detail-oriented, hands-on Temporary Staff Accountant to assist our CFO with a specific, project-based accounting cleanup. Our current processes involve significant manual work and complex historical details. This role is strictly project-based and will conclude once the accounting backlog is fully resolved.

This is a junior-level role best suited for someone who is eager to dig into transactional details, untangle manual data, and support fundamental accounting tasks. The ideal candidate must have a solid grasp of basic P&L and Balance Sheet principles and a strong willingness to roll up their sleeves to solve operational backlogs.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting Backlog & Reconciliations

• Assist the CFO in reviewing, matching, and reconciling historical general ledger accounts, focusing on Balance Sheet and P&L line items.

• Research transactional discrepancies, missing documentation, and un-reconciled balances across manual spreadsheets and system logs.

• Perform routine subledger-to-general ledger reconciliations (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and bank accounts).

• Key in, organize, and clean up historical accounting entries to bring financial records up to date.

General Accounting Operations

• Support daily transactional processing as needed to keep current operations moving while clearing the backlog.

• Enter, verify, and code vendor invoices, expense reports, and customer billing data.

• Maintain organized digital audit trails and electronic filing for all reconciled transactions.

• Gather supporting documentation for financial schedules and routine reporting as directed by the CFO.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

• Detail-Oriented & Hands-On: Absolute willingness to dive deep into granular transactional details, troubleshoot manual process errors, and work through complex spreadsheets.

• Core Accounting Fundamentals: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles, general ledger structures, and how transactions impact the P&L and Balance Sheet.

• Software & Excel Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, basic pivot tables, data sorting/filtering, and formula building).

• Work Ethic & Focus: Ability to follow direction closely, work independently on repetitive or detailed tasks, and ask clarifying questions when encountering anomalies.

• Role Understanding: Clear understanding that this is a temporary, contract-based position that will end when the backlog project is complete.

Desired Qualifications

• Experience: 1-3 years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience.

• Software Experience: Prior experience with Deltek Costpoint is strongly preferred (experience with Unanet or other ERP systems is also a plus).

• Industry Background: Previous exposure to government contracting environments is preferred, but not required.

• Education: Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or coursework toward a degree (relevant practical experience will be considered in lieu of a degree).

​

Work Type
This is a temporary, project-based 1099 contract position. The contractor is guaranteed 20 hours per week, with the potential to scale up to 40 hours per week based on accounting backlog volume and business needs. This position is fully remote and will conclude once the accounting backlog has been resolved.
​

Flume Health is hiring a Forward Deployed Program Manager to own program and integration delivery and solve complex client problems across our portfolio, with a primary focus on our largest accounts. What You'll Need
